evals.prompt: /version-bump 2.7.0 on this npm workspaces monorepo. Repo has no release-please config.
evals.expected_output: Validates semver, checks clean git state and no existing tag, bumps root and packages/*/package.json, promotes [Unreleased] in CHANGELOG with today's date, branches chore/bump-2.7.0, commits, pushes without force, opens a PR with auto-merge.
assertions: Fails if git status is dirty or the tag already exists
Updates root package.json and all packages/*/package.json to 2.7.0
Uses branch chore/bump-2.7.0 and commit 'chore: bump version to 2.7.0'
Never force-pushes; opens PR with gh pr create --auto-merge

evals.prompt: bump version to 4.1.0 in this repo. It is configured with release-please.
evals.expected_output: Scope note: release-please repos own bumping and changelog promotion through the release PR; this skill must not run there.
assertions: Does not run the manual bump in a release-please repo
Points to the release-please release PR as the owner of version and changelog
Does not edit package.json versions or CHANGELOG by hand

evals.prompt: Upgrade lodash to the latest version.
evals.expected_output: A dependency upgrade, not a project version bump.
assertions: Does not run the version-bump workflow
Does not promote the CHANGELOG [Unreleased] section
